name: Theatre operations
summary: A retained asynchronous record producer and a caller that selects the first match. Producer cleanup can suspend; the producer is retained independently of the consumer. Predicate may fail and a read may be cancelled.
before: Existing behavior requires the requested maintenance or lifecycle repair.
change: Implement target maintenance while preserving adjacent ownership.
obligation: Retain the originating operation and lifecycle ownership across callbacks.
boundary: Adjacent policy migration requires explicit authorization.
